sources.entry: logfire - The observability platform for Python, from the makers of Pydantic.

summary.one_liner: Pydantic Logfire is the open-source Python SDK and documentation for the Logfire observability platform, whose server side is closed source.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the Python SDK (installed as the `logfire` package, with the CLI included) and the documentation for Logfire. The SDK provides manual tracing and logging through `logfire.info` and `logfire.span`, with f-string-style message templates and keyword fields. It offers integrations with popular Python packages, with FastAPI shown in the README via `logfire.instrument_fastapi(app)`. The README says the SDK is built on OpenTelemetry and can export data to any OTel-compatible backend. It also describes support for all OpenTelemetry signals (traces, metrics, logs) and Pydantic validation analytics. The data-recording and dashboard server is not in this repository.
use_cases: add structured logging and tracing to a Python app
instrument a FastAPI service for observability
export OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs from Python
debug Python code and database queries in production
notable: Built on OpenTelemetry, with an opinionated wrapper API
SDKs also exist for TypeScript and Rust, per the README
Can export to any OTel-compatible backend
caveats: The Logfire server and dashboard are closed source; self-hosting requires purchasing an enterprise license
This repo holds only the SDK and docs, so it cannot record or display data by itself
The README does not state a pricing model for the hosted service
